dedupe_keys.name: modelling the high voltage grid using open data for europe and beyond

description: Modelling the high-voltage grid using open data for Europe and beyond is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Bobby Xiong et al. This paper provides the background, methodology and validation for constructing a representation of the European high-voltage grid (AC lines from 220 to 750 kV and all DC lines) based on OpenStreetMap data. Grid components include commissioned substations, transmission lines and cables, transformers, and converters as well as technical parameters based on standard types. Coverage: continental; published in 2025. Formats: CSV. The data are held in arXiv and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
